articles.title: Tesla Teases Oct. 1 Event to Showcase Next-Generation Roadster
articles.summary: Tesla Inc. teased an Oct. 1 event to showcase its next-generation Roadster vehicle, a niche product that CEO Elon Musk first unveiled in November 2017.

articles.title: SpaceX to Get Weighting Boost in Nasdaq 100 After Rebalance
articles.summary: SpaceX is set to get a larger weighting in the Nasdaq 100 later this month, a change that could trigger billions of dollars of buying by passive funds tied to the benchmark.

articles.title: Nvidia Mulls $10 Billion Anthropic IPO Backing, Reuters Says
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp. is considering investing as much as $10 billion in Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering, which could become the biggest IPO of all time, Reuters reported.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Altman Says No IPO in 2026, Firm to Prioritize Safety
articles.summary: OpenAI won’t go public in this year as the artificial intelligence company focuses on addressing safety-related concerns around the technology, Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman told Fortune in an interview.

articles.title: 아이폰 듀오 돌풍 예고…"애플, 폴더블폰 시장 24.8% 점유"

articles.title: 美 물가지표 예상 부합에…비트코인, 7만 7000달러선 회복
